task: Keep the per-page 'Show: N items' selector visible in the shared Pagination component for a single page on the project Members tab, hiding page numbers, without changing other consumers.

key_reasoning.reason: Ticket claims 13 consumers have no perPage selector, but analysis shows nearly all pass perPage; an opt-in prop vs broader behavior change is an open design decision. Scored M (not higher) because the fix is small either way.

Pagination is a shared component imported by 15 files; closest pattern is the existing pageNumbers.length > 1 gating, which covers the logic but the blast radius needs an opt-in guard. No security implications. Single-page branch is untested.
